staleness_risks: OWASP taxonomy, model cards, API categories, SDK policies and legal timelines can change; verify the named edition and version before reuse.
The linked CanLII tribunal decision returned HTTP 403 to automated reading; the wording is limited to the case-level conclusion, without treating it as general legal advice.
Public demonstrations of Bing, Chevrolet and Slack AI behavior do not by themselves establish a completed transaction or a production data-loss count.
LLM_READY is authoring evidence, not independent blind review or FINAL acceptance.
